result.summary: Found several layout and content issues: truncated restaurant names, partially cut-off category chips and restaurant cards, and incomplete bottom navigation visibility.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you section, making the full name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line names, reduce font size, or use ellipsis with full name on tap; ensure cards have enough width or wrap text properly.

issues.description: Category filter chips row is cut off on the right (partial chip visible after Healthy), and the third restaurant card in Fastest near you is partially clipped at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll areas have proper padding/margin so content isn't flush-cut, and indicate scrollability more clearly if intentional.

issues.description: Bottom tab bar icons appear incomplete or poorly spaced; the bookmark/orders icon sits under a thin bar and home is the only clearly active state, which can look broken.
issues.suggestion: Review tab bar layout, icon alignment, and safe-area padding so all four tabs render fully and consistently.

issues.description: Popular right now pizza card shows only a discount badge with no restaurant name or delivery info visible in the viewport (card appears cut off at bottom).
issues.suggestion: Ensure full card content (name, ETA, fee) is visible or that scroll position doesn't leave orphaned image-only cards looking incomplete.
